not_covered: Google acquired Wiz in March 2025 to close the security gap with competitors AWS and Azure, positioning cloud-security consolidation as a critical battleground in the ongoing "cloud wars" [Source: ev-1].
The company also bet on AI-driven cloud adoption as the primary demand driver for this sector [Source: ev-1].
This was underscored by the transaction size of approximately $32 billion in an all-cash deal, which marked the largest acquisition in Google's history [Source: ev-1].
Additionally, the final price reflected competitive pressure during negotiations, following Wiz’s rejection of Google’s earlier $23 billion offer in July 2024 [Source: ev-1].
